clips.caption:
Even your favorite show belongs on the calendar.

Kevin explains that he schedules the things he enjoys, like an evening show. Once it's written in, he can protect that time and enjoy it without guilt.

If something better comes up, he simply moves it. His habit is to write down every single appointment, personal as well as business.

What do you love doing that you never schedule?
